title: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane could see 40-plus touches in some games this season, Jeff Hafley says

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane could see 40-plus touches in some games this season, Jeff Hafley says
sources.description: Achane is coming off a Pro Bowl campaign in 2025, during which he piled up a career-high 1,838 scrimmage yards and once again logged 12 total touchdowns.
